proposition.claim:
dim_H supp(mu^beta)=1-2/beta for beta>2 and dim_H supp(mu^2)=0

The p.68 tail split prints P(integral_0^t 4(1-X_u)/(beta*u) du <= alpha), then claims a limsup bounded only by the Brownian supremum tail.

repair.content:
Use dim_H mu=inf{dim_H E:mu(E)=1}, or explicitly specify a full-measure carrier and the precise dimensional assertion furnished by Simon's theorem.

Replace <= alpha inside the first probability on p.68 by >= alpha, as on p.67. The t->0 limit then kills that probability; alpha->0 kills the Brownian supremum tail.
